mapper.select: SELECT timer.id, timer.ticket_id, timer.sla_policy_id, timer.timer_type, timer.status, timer.threshold_minutes, timer.elapsed_minutes, timer.base_elapsed_minutes, timer.start_at, timer.pause_at, timer.deadline, timer.breached_at, timer.completed_at, timer.is_warned, timer.is_breached, timer.create_time, timer.update_time, timer.create_by, timer.update_by, timer.deleted FROM sla_timer timer INNER JOIN ticket t ON t.id = timer.ticket_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE timer.status = 'RUNNING' AND timer.deleted = 0 AND UPPER(TRIM(t.status)) NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED')

update.foreach: UPDATE sla_timer SET status = #{item.status}, elapsed_minutes = #{item.elapsedMinutes}, is_warned = #{item.isWarned}, is_breached = #{item.isBreached}, breached_at = #{item.breachedAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{item.id} AND deleted = 0
